name: player_find_nearest_third_person_camera_probe_point
description: Player::FindNearestThirdPersonCameraProbePoint scans camera probe hit batches for the nearest node-backed hit to a reference point and copies that hit position to the output.
known_limits: Binary Ninja disassembly/HLIL for 0x42b6e0 validates fastcall ECX=batches, EDX=batchCount, stack arguments referencePos and outHitPos, return 0 when no node-backed candidate exists, first-valid seed selection, zMath::Vec3DeltaLengthSq comparisons against referencePos, nearest hit position copy to outHitPos, and return 1 on success.

The native smoke verifies null-node hits are ignored, the nearest hit can be selected from later candidates, the output position is copied, and the no-valid-hit path returns 0 without changing the output vector.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x42b6e0 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a coherent Player camera/source-cluster pass.
